source.description: Scanned University of Abuja campus plan supplied to the Nelavista team on 2026-11-21. Rotated 90 degrees anticlockwise so the main road and Central Admin are at the top and the labels read normally. Positions and outlines are measured from that scan in its own pixel frame; nothing is geolocated.
not_on_source: Faculty of Allied Health Sciences (the plan says only 'Faculty Health Science')
A separate Faculty of ICT (the plan shows an 'ICT Centre', marked 5)
illegible_on_source: White labels on the dark buildings either side of and below the Garden (six blocks)
Small gatehouse-style building by the top-left road junction
Unlabelled rectangular buildings at the ends of the top-right and bottom-left access roads
